static_traits.name: Chen Mingyu
static_traits.social_status: Has a few friends to communicate with, but Reducing participation in social activities for fear of being judged; not yet discussed the feeling of being misunderstood with friends.
static_traits.medical_history: Without significant physical illness; without similar psychological problem history in the past; never received psychotherapy.
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, fairly good logic, cooperation Good; slightly nervous and worried when talking about being judged, cautious tone.

basic_info.main_problem: Feeling judged and misunderstood for liking video games, especially Increased stress in Social situations and when discussing interests.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because I realized these feelings of being misunderstood are affecting my confidence and causing distress in social situations.
growth_experiences: A few months ago, a colleague made the comment that 'video games are a waste of time', and afterward others expressed similar views; because of this the client became more self-conscious and nervous in social situations, and gradually chose to hide or downplay their interest in video games, avoiding talking about it lest they be judged.

core_beliefs: My value depends on others' evaluations
Liking video games shows I am not mature enough / not good enough

special_situations.event: A colleague comments 'video games are a waste of time'; afterwards others make similar remarks
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others belittle my hobby, it means I am immature, not worthy of respect
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: At work and in social situations, avoids mentioning games and downplays interests, reducing chances to discuss them
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Everyone will think I am childish and wasting time

special_situations.event: At Social gatherings or when talking about hobbies
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: To be accepted, my hobbies must be 'mainstream-approved', otherwise I will be looked down on
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Changes the topic, hides interests, avoids in-depth discussion
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Once games are mentioned they will look down on me

special_situations.event: When noticing friends hold a neutral / positive attitude toward one's gaming hobby
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Negative feedback is more 'real', positive or neutral reactions do not count
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignores or belittles positive evidence, repeatedly focuses on negative evaluations
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This friendliness is just politeness, the true majority still looks down

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: As soon as games are mentioned, I will definitely lose face and be mocked
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Rehearsing avoidance strategies in advance, reducing self-exposure
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This time will surely be labeled childish again

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be accepted and respected, able to express own interests authentically without being shamed
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being belittled, excluded, appearing immature and losing the sense of worth
defense_goal: Reducing the risk of being shamed and Being rejected by hiding interests and avoiding related topics
Keeps a safe distance from potential critics to protect self-esteem

object_relations.self_representation: A 'not-mature-enough person' needing to hide true interests, easily looked down on
object_relations.object_representation: Harsh, contemptuous others (colleagues/groups) who are ready to judge at any time

object_relations.self_representation: A self that is understood and accepted

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor asks 'what evidence supports' most people look down on gamers''
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Experiencing the counselor's inquiry as potential negation of own interests (like colleagues' judgment)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Cautious tone, using vague wording (like 'everyone thinks so'), avoiding concrete examples, slightly defensively emphasizing 'it is not only me who thinks this'.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing embarrassment and shame experiences in social settings
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Talking about group views in a generalized, rationalized way, thus keeping distance from uncomfortable emotions
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using objective, generalized expressions (like 'from the mainstream view......'), reducing first-person feeling words, steady tone, avoiding concrete emotional depiction.

manifestations: Hiding interests to cater to others' evaluations, feeling self-expression restricted
Internalizes the rule of 'should have a more serious hobby', going against one's true preferences
outcomes: Withdrawal in social situations, avoiding exposing the true self

manifestations: Reducing participation in social activities for fear of being judged
Feeling misunderstood, unwilling to talk to friends about true feelings
outcomes: Reduced use of Social support, weakened sense of connection

manifestations: Internalizing the voice that views video games as 'not worthwhile / a waste of time'
Questioning the value and meaning of their investment

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths.
manifestations: Treats the external evaluation 'video games are a waste of time' as a universal truth
Self-demand of 'should have a more serious hobby', restricting self-expression accordingly

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact.
manifestations: Actively changes the topic in socializing to avoid talking about games
Avoids deep communication when feeling judged

contact_model.definition: The individual is excessively self-restricting and self-berating, overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: Overly caring about how others view one's interests
Worrying about appearing 'childish / not worthwhile', acting extra cautiously in speech and actions

exception_events.target_problem: When discussing interests in Social situations, the client typically Anticipates being judged and chooses to avoid or downplay own gaming interest.
exception_events.unique_outcome: When gathering with several familiar friends (who also usually play together), the client naturally mentioned and shared own gaming hobby, the others did not make negative comments, even joined in; at the time he felt more relaxed and accepted.
exception_events.reason: Cues: different relationship (friends supportive, atmosphere safe); different situation (familiar social circle); different understanding (noticing not everyone holds negative views).

positive_force: Has a supportive friend network that can provide neutral / positive feedback
Able to Reflection and Identify automatic thought patterns, willing to do reality testing
Stable work functioning, basically intact life structure
Willing to take the step of seeking help; good motivation and cooperation
negative_force: Overgeneralization and mind reading leading to magnified understanding of others' evaluations
Self-worth centered on external evaluation (seeking external validation)
Social and topic avoidance maintaining the shame-Withdrawal vicious cycle
Mental filtering / negating positive evidence, intensifying self-confirmation of negative beliefs

target_behavior.behavior: In social settings, avoids or downplays talking about interest in video games
antecedent: Social gatherings or topics about hobbies appearing
Hears or recalls others' negative comments about games
target_behavior.core_reason: Fearing being belittled, being labeled 'childish / wasting time', trying to avoid shame and Being rejected.
target_behavior.function: Escaping unwelcome emotions and possible negative evaluations, relieving Anxiety and embarrassment in the short term.
target_behavior.consequence: Reduced social participation, Damaged confidence, overall mood and Decreased drive.

target_behavior.behavior: Anticipatory Anxiety before socializing (repeatedly assuming others will evaluate negatively)
antecedent: About to attend a gathering, or occasions where interests are expected to be discussed
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophic predictions of others' evaluations and mind reading maintain the sense of threat.
target_behavior.function: Prompting Self-protection (like avoidance / hiding) by presetting threats in advance, to reduce on-the-spot shame risk.
target_behavior.consequence: Tension increases, mood is low, tends toward more avoidance, limiting opportunities for positive experiences.
